text: The Global Shield engagement in the Philippines is part of the Global Shield Solutions Platform (GSSP) aimed at providing financial protection against climate and disaster risks. It involves the development of pre-arranged finance solutions such as parametric insurance and risk transfer mechanisms to ensure rapid financial disbursement in the event of climate-related disasters. The initiative is part of a broader V20-G7 effort to enhance financial resilience in vulnerable countries.
